title: VendPoint Handling Schedule for Returned Start-Up Items by Product Category
content:
Schedule of handling shares on the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program for unused units of the item most recently added to a machine and returned into it during its start-up months.

The handling share follows the product category on the item's add entry: an item in the safety and PPE category gives the PPE handling share, an item in the cutting tools or the abrasives category gives the consumable handling share, and any other item gives a share of one.

| Product category on the add entry | Handling share |
|---|---|
| Safety and PPE | 0.9 (PPE handling share) |
| Cutting tools | 0.97 (consumable handling share) |
| Abrasives | 0.97 (consumable handling share) |
| Every other category | 1 |

The category is the one written on the item's add entry in the machine's selection history. Hypothetical examples: returned safety glasses added under safety and PPE give 0.9; a returned drill bit added under cutting tools gives 0.97; a returned light fitting added under lighting gives 1.
